summary: MikiLab Pro — v14 site-wide perfection modules FRONTEND end-to-end verification (Layout per Ruolo, Gestione Silos, Celle Adattive, Flotta AGV). All acceptance criteria PASS. Backend endpoints /api/bako/silos, /api/bako/proofing, /api/bako/agv verified via curl. Frontend rendered all data-testid nodes, role toggles instantly show/hide correct panels with getComputedStyle(display) confirmation, persistence to localStorage works, no runtime errors, no horizontal overflow at 390px.
critical_code_review_comments: RoleLayout.jsx: 'panel-proofing' is NOT in ROLE_PANELS.manutentore. This is likely correct per spec (manutentore focuses on machines), but note that the spec text lists panels manutentore should show without proofing; consistent. However, panel-proofing is also not in capolinea list — a line supervisor might want to see proofing state. Consider adding to capolinea if desired.
SiloManager polling: 8s interval hits /api/bako/silos on every open dashboard tab; consider using SSE or shared cache to reduce backend load when multiple panels visible.

AgvFleet: TTS alert is triggered only on cart-id change of alerts[0]. If a different AGV starts alerting after AGV-1 recovers, the ref is cleared only when alerts is empty — edge case: consecutive alerts on different carts without an empty gap would still speak only once. Consider tracking a Set of spoken cart ids.
AdaptiveProofing: setInterval(load, 8000) does not clear when 'manual' changes to a value that would fire fewer loads — acceptable, but worth noting.
server.py > 12,800 lines — modularise (carried over from previous iterations).
seed_data_creation: None; used seeded silos/AGV. Backend seed_silos/seed_agv worked as expected.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fast path still valid: page.request.post for /api/admin-gate/verify + /api/auth/login (shared context cookies), then goto /, localStorage.setItem('mikilab_admin_unlocked','1'), reload domcontentloaded (not networkidle — polling every 4-8s). IMPORTANT: HoloPanel accordions default to COLLAPSED — child components like silo-manager/adaptive-proofing/agv-fleet only mount when the panel is expanded. To trigger expansion programmatically: `document.querySelector('[data-testid="panel-silos"]').querySelector('button').click()`. Backend deterministic values for regression: /api/bako/proofing?free_ovens=0 → 218 min FRENA, ?free_ovens=2 → 101 min ACCELERA (both stable in current seed). AGV-1 acoustic_db drifts (~76-80 dB) so alert is reliably present.
rca of the issue: N/A — all four new modules and role-based layout meet the review criteria.
